title: Ambient derived categories have coproducts
statement: For every scheme X, the derived category of sheaves of modules on X has set-indexed coproducts.

proof.text: For a family E indexed by any Type u, use essential surjectivity of DerivedCategory.Q to choose K(i) = Q.objPreimage(E(i)) and e(i) = Q.objObjPreimageIso(E(i)). Form the cofan with point Q of the termwise coproduct and legs e(i).inv followed by Q of each coprojection. Apply derivedAmbientDirectSums to obtain its IsColimit witness. Apply Mathlib hasCoproducts_of_colimit_cofans to these chosen cofans; this reindexes any functor on a discrete category using Discrete.natIsoFunctor. The construction includes the empty family.
